summary: First full test run of Cafe Del Nord MVP. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass covering public menu/settings/featured/reservations (validation + rate limit), auth (Bearer token, 401 no token, 403 viewer, 200 admin), and full admin CRUD (categories/items/settings/campaigns/reservation-status). Frontend (desktop + mobile): homepage, /menu filter+search, /rezervasyon submit, /galeri lightbox, /iletisim map, /admin gate, /admin dashboard w/ session_token cookie (all 5 tabs render, reservations list shows created records) all working.
action_items: None functional. NOTE for docs/PM: several data-testid names in the review request differ from actual code (reservation form uses `reservation-name-input`/`reservation-phone-input`/.../`reservation-submit-btn`; gallery lightbox uses `lightbox-close-btn`/`lightbox-prev-btn`/`lightbox-next-btn`; no `gallery-close`/`reservation-name` etc.). Consider aligning the spec or renaming so future testers use identical IDs.

Mobile menu drawer: `mobile-menu-toggle` is present; there is no single `mobile-nav` container testid, only per-link `mobile-nav-link-{key}`. If a container is desired for e2e, add data-testid="mobile-nav" to the opened drawer.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `_id` is properly excluded in all Mongo reads (good).
server.py: rate_limit is in-memory per process — acceptable for single-worker preview; will not be shared across replicas in prod. Fine for MVP.
server.py: create_reservation/rate_limit runs AFTER Pydantic validation, so 422 responses do NOT consume rate-limit tokens (verified in test).
server.py: /auth/session sets cookie with samesite=None + secure (correct for cross-site iframe/preview).
server.py: PUT admin endpoints use `body: dict` and manually filter allowed keys — safe but loses Pydantic validation of types; consider Pydantic partial models for stricter typing.
server.py: seed only runs when categories collection is empty; safe idempotent behaviour.
test_credentials: MongoDB-seeded test admin session: token=test_session_admin_1787840617697 (role=admin), viewer token=test_session_viewer_1787840617697 (role=viewer). Real login via Emergent Google OAuth.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 2 users + 2 sessions into MongoDB (test_database.users / test_database.user_sessions) for auth testing. Created several TEST_-prefixed reservations via API. TEST_ campaigns/categories/items were created & deleted within the CRUD test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Session tokens above are valid 7 days. If DB is reset, re-run the mongosh block in /app/auth_testing.md. Rate-limit for /api/reservations is 5 req / 5 min per IP; if you re-run the rate-limit test twice in a row expect 429 quickly (in-memory). Reservation form testids all end with `-input` / `-btn`. Gallery lightbox testids are `lightbox-{close|prev|next}-btn`. Admin dashboard requires cookie name `session_token`, path=/, secure=True, sameSite=None.
